Name: Alan Hodgson

focus: North/South divide, employment (especially green and engineering/manufacturing jobs), education, special educational needs and disabilities, health (especially cancer and public health issues), transport, child poverty, child hunger and nutrition, free school meals, ticket touting, arts education, basketball, culture (especially arts, creative industries and heritage), LGBT issues, automotive industry.
